chunks: Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from ʿAbd al-Rahman ibn Abi ʿAbdillah, who said: Abu ʿAbdillah عليه السلام said:
A woman is returned for four things: vitiligo, leprosy, insanity, and al-qaran and al-ʿafal, so long as he has not had intercourse with her; but if he has had intercourse with her, then no.

key_terms.الْبَرَصِ: vitiligo or a severe depigmenting skin condition
key_terms.الْعَفَلِ: a genital defect or fleshy obstruction
key_terms.الْقَرَنِ: a genital obstruction or defect preventing intercourse
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman or wife in the marriage contract
key_terms.تُرَدُّ: is returned, meaning the marriage is revoked or annulled
key_terms.وَقَعَ: had sexual intercourse or consummated the marriage

ai.seo_question: When can a marriage be annulled because of defects in the wife according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning annulment in marriage due to specific defects found in the wife. It states that annulment applies before consummation, but after consummation this right no longer remains in these cases.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4495 - Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Abdur-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah, who said:
Abu Abdillah (as) said: "

A woman can be returned (in marriage) for four reasons; leprosy, vitiligo, insanity, and genital defects (imperforation or obstruction), as long as the marriage has not been consummated.
However, if consummation has taken place, then she cannot be returned."
